query: INSERT INTO photos(id,short_id,album_id,title,original_hash,original_name,original_bytes,mime,kind,status,visibility,width,height) SELECT id,short,$3,'Person photo',repeat('a',64),'fixture.jpg',1,'image/jpeg','image','ready','restricted',640,480 FROM unnest($1::uuid[],$2::text[]) AS p(id,short)
